record.paper_title: Advances in periodic difference equations with open problems
record.original_question: Suppose an unknown p-periodic system [f0, …, f_{p-1}] has a known folded system [F0, F1, …, F_{p/gcd(p,k)}]. Compare the periodic structure of the original unfolded system with the periodic structure of the delay equation x_{n+1} = F_n(x_{n-(k-1)}), where the index n is taken periodically through the folded maps. What similarity, if any, must these two systems have in their sets of periodic behaviors?

evidence.quote: From the columns of this matrix, observe that each column gives a periodic system of period p/gcd(p,k), which can be assumed to be the minimal period.

Open Problem 3.2. Suppose there is a p-periodic system [f0, ..., fp−1], which is unknown to us, but we know one of its folded systems [F0, F1, . . . , F p/gcd(p,k)]. What kind of similarity (if any) in periodic structure do we have between the unfolded p-periodic system [f0, ..., fp−1] and the periodic system with delay xn+1 = Fn(xn−(k−1))?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let p and k be positive integers. A p-periodic non-autonomous discrete dynamical system on a set X is a sequence of maps [f_0, f_1, …, f_{p-1}] with f_i : X → X, generating the dynamics x_{n+1} = f_{n mod p}(x_n).

The k-folding of such a system produces a new periodic system [F_0, F_1, …, F_{q-1}], where q = p/gcd(p,k), defined by composing every k-th map along the period: explicitly, for each j,
F_j = f_{j+(k-1) mod p} ∘ f_{j+(k-2) mod p} ∘ ⋯ ∘ f_{j mod p},
so that the iterates of the folded system at step k correspond to iterates of the original system.

Suppose the original p-periodic system [f_0, …, f_{p-1}] is unknown, but one of its folded systems [F_0, F_1, …, F_{q-1}] (with q = p/gcd(p,k)) is known. Consider the q-periodic delay difference equation
x_{n+1} = F_{n mod q}(x_{n-(k-1)}),
whose state at time n depends on x_{n-(k-1)}.

Determine what similarity, if any, must hold between the set of periodic orbits (and more generally the periodic structure) of the unknown unfolded p-periodic system [f_0, …, f_{p-1}] and that of the q-periodic delay system x_{n+1} = F_{n mod q}(x_{n-(k-1)}). In particular, can the periodic behaviors of one system be characterized in terms of the periodic behaviors of the other?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open problem in a survey on periodic difference equations. Web searches do not reveal a published resolution comparing the periodic structure of an unfolded p-periodic system with that of the associated delay equation built from its folded system; the question appears to remain open.
